_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Data Structure profile UML. Aligned to metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifDataStructure/schema.yaml. Carries the structural model (variants + components + keys), the variable model (RepresentedVariable / DescriptorVariable), the value-domain model (Substantive/Sentinel/DescriptorValueDomain + EnumerationDomain + ValueAndConceptDescription), UnitType, plus the CdifConceptOrTerm union shorthand. cdi:DataStructureComponent is the abstract parent of five concrete component subtypes (Identifier/Measure/Attribute/Dimension/VariableValue); VariableDescriptorComponent is standalone because it is defined by a DescriptorVariable, not a RepresentedVariable. Per-variant has-edges are kept so the diagram still expresses which subtypes each concrete variant accepts.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Data Structure Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Data Structure Profile
targetModel.subTitle: DataStructure variants + components + keys + variables + value domains + units
targetModel.definition: CDIF Data Structure profile module. Adds cdi:isStructuredBy on a DataDownload, pointing at one of four DataStructure variants - DataStructure (general; any component subtype), DimensionalDataStructure (Identifier/Measure/Attribute/Dimension), LongDataStructure (Identifier/VariableDescriptor/VariableValue/Attribute), WideDataStructure (Identifier/Measure/Attribute). Each structure may also carry a PrimaryKey and ForeignKeys. RepresentedVariables carry value domains (substantive / sentinel), an intended data type, a unit type (measures), and concept references (cdif:uses -> CdifConceptOrTerm). The catalog record (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord) MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.1.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Data structure description extension classes added by this profile.

package.name: Structures
package.definition: The four concrete DataStructure variants (DataStructure / Dimensional / Long / Wide) plus DimensionGroup.

package.name: Components
package.definition: Abstract cdi:DataStructureComponent + six concrete subtypes (Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension / VariableValue / VariableDescriptor). Five generalize the abstract; VariableDescriptorComponent is standalone (defined by a DescriptorVariable, not a RepresentedVariable).

package.name: Keys
package.definition: PrimaryKey + ForeignKey. Both are composed of RepresentedVariables (cdif:isComposedOf); ForeignKey additionally references a PrimaryKey on another structure (cdi:references).

package.name: Variables
package.definition: RepresentedVariable (defines the component) and DescriptorVariable (defines a VariableDescriptorComponent specifically).

package.name: ValueDomains
package.definition: Substantive / Sentinel / Descriptor ValueDomain, the EnumerationDomain a value domain can take values from, ValueAndConceptDescription (range / pattern / classification-level description), and UnitType (cdi:measures target).

package.name: Concepts
package.definition: schema:DefinedTerm reference target + the CdifConceptOrTerm union shorthand used as the value type of cdif:uses.

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of classes from cdifCore / cdifDataDescription this profile attaches to or references.

class._comment: DataDownload stub - the host for cdi:isStructuredBy. Full definition in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::DataDownload. The data-structure profile adds the cdi:isStructuredBy property on each schema:distribution DataDownload item, pointing at one of the four DataStructure variants.

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - carries the required https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.1 conformance declaration.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord. For the data-structure profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.1. Typed schema:Dataset with schema:additionalType 'dcat:CatalogRecord' (Jun-2026 schema:subjectOf shape fix).

attribute.name: additionalType
attribute.definition: schema:additionalType - MUST include 'dcat:CatalogRecord' (@type array itself is schema:Dataset).

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - MUST include the constant https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.1 for the data-structure profile.

attribute.name: about
attribute.definition: schema:about - @id back-pointer to the described Dataset.

class._comment: DataStructure - the general variant. Accepts ANY component subtype. Optional PrimaryKey + ForeignKey.
class.definition: Generic data organization. Carries at least one cdi:has_DataStructureComponent (any of the six concrete component subtypes), plus optional cdi:has_PrimaryKey and cdi:has_ForeignKey[].

class._comment: DimensionalDataStructure - cube-shaped. Components restricted to Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension.
class.definition: Dimensional data set (multidimensional cube). Components are restricted to Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension. Optional PrimaryKey and ForeignKey.

class._comment: LongDataStructure - narrow / variable-value-pair row layout. Exactly one Identifier + VariableDescriptor + VariableValue (required); optional Attribute.
class.definition: Long (narrow) dataset row layout. Required: exactly one IdentifierComponent, one VariableDescriptorComponent, one VariableValueComponent. Optional AttributeComponents. Optional PrimaryKey.

class._comment: WideDataStructure - wide-format tabular layout. Components restricted to Identifier / Measure / Attribute.
class.definition: Wide (tabular) dataset layout. Components restricted to Identifier / Measure / Attribute. Optional PrimaryKey and ForeignKey.

class._comment: DimensionGroup - reusable collection of dimensions referenced across multiple dimensional structures.
class.definition: Reusable collection of dimensions that can be shared across multiple dimensional structures. Carries cdi:identifier, cdif:name, cdif:has_DataStructureComponent (any subtype).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the dimension group.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: cdif:name - human-readable name for the dimension group (ISO/IEC 11179-5).

class._comment: Abstract cdi:DataStructureComponent - parent of the five concrete component subtypes that are defined by a RepresentedVariable. VariableDescriptorComponent is NOT a subtype (it is defined by a DescriptorVariable instead). Generic edges (DataStructure_has_DataStructureComponent, DataStructureComponent_isDefinedBy_RepresentedVariable) anchor here; per-variant edges to concrete subtypes specify which subtypes each structure variant accepts.
class.definition: Abstract supertype of the component types defined by a RepresentedVariable (Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension / VariableValue). Target of the generic cdi:has_DataStructureComponent and DataStructureComponent_isDefinedBy_RepresentedVariable; concrete subtypes generalize it.

attribute.name: type
attribute.definition: @type must contain a concrete subtype constant (cdi:IdentifierComponent / MeasureComponent / AttributeComponent / DimensionComponent / VariableValueComponent).

class._comment: IdentifierComponent - role of a data structure component for content identification. Used by all four DataStructure variants.
class.definition: Data-structure component for content identification. Used by all four DataStructure variants.

class._comment: MeasureComponent - data structure component representing measure values. Used by general DataStructure, Dimensional, Wide.
class.definition: Data-structure component representing a measure (the values being recorded). Used by general DataStructure, Dimensional, and Wide structures.

class._comment: AttributeComponent - data structure component for qualifying / contextual attribute values. Used by all four DataStructure variants.
class.definition: Data-structure component representing an attribute (qualifying or contextual value alongside the primary measures). Used by all four DataStructure variants.

class._comment: DimensionComponent - data structure component for a dimension along which measures vary. Specific to general DataStructure and DimensionalDataStructure.
class.definition: Data-structure component representing a dimension along which measures vary. Specific to dimensional / cube structures.

class._comment: VariableValueComponent - carries the actual value for the variable identified by a VariableDescriptorComponent. Specific to general DataStructure and LongDataStructure.
class.definition: Data-structure component carrying the value for the variable named by a VariableDescriptorComponent in a long-format row.

class._comment: VariableDescriptorComponent - identifies which InstanceVariable a long-format row represents. Defined by a DescriptorVariable (not a RepresentedVariable), so it does NOT generalize the abstract DataStructureComponent.
class.definition: Data-structure component naming which InstanceVariable a long-format row represents (the descriptor column). Specific to LongDataStructure (exactly one required) and the general DataStructure. Standalone: defined by a DescriptorVariable rather than a RepresentedVariable.

class._comment: PrimaryKey - role of an ordered set of RepresentedVariables uniquely identifying a data instance.
class.definition: Role of an ordered set of cdi:RepresentedVariables that uniquely identify each data instance. Position is implicit in cdif:isComposedOf array order; each membership carries a cdif:position integer.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this primary key.

class._comment: ForeignKey - role of a set of RepresentedVariables for content referencing. Composed of RepresentedVariables and references a PrimaryKey on another structure.
class.definition: Role of a set of cdi:RepresentedVariables for content referencing. cdi:isComposedOf is a list of RepresentedVariables in this structure; cdi:references is the PrimaryKey in another structure that this foreign key references.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this foreign key.

class._comment: RepresentedVariable - the conceptual variable that defines a DataStructureComponent. Carries value domains (substantive/sentinel), an intended data type, an optional UnitType, and concept references via cdif:uses.

DescriptorVariable - the variable type defining a VariableDescriptorComponent in long-format structures. Its values are descriptors that identify the role of associated VariableValueComponent values; it has a DescriptorValueDomain rather than the substantive/sentinel pair.

SubstantiveValueDomain - the set of valid, meaningful values a RepresentedVariable can take (cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom). May take values from an EnumerationDomain and be described by a ValueAndConceptDescription.
SentinelValueDomain - missing-value / not-applicable codes for a RepresentedVariable (cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom). Same shape as SubstantiveValueDomain.

DescriptorValueDomain - the value domain a DescriptorVariable draws its descriptor values from (cdif:hasValuesFrom). Same shape as the Substantive/Sentinel pair but used by DescriptorVariable rather than RepresentedVariable.
EnumerationDomain - extension point letting a value domain reference a controlled-vocabulary codelist (cdif:takesValuesFrom -> CDIF codelist / skos:ConceptScheme).

ValueAndConceptDescription - description of the values/concepts a value domain admits: ranges, patterns, classification level, format pattern, recommended datatype, semantic note, external definition.
UnitType - the type of unit a RepresentedVariable measures (cdi:measures target). cdi:UnitType.
schema:DefinedTerm - referenced by CdifConceptOrTerm (and used as the target of cdi:hasIntendedDataType / cdif:recommendedDataType). Minimal stub: termCode + name + inDefinedTermSet.
class.definition: schema:DefinedTerm - a term from a controlled vocabulary (DefinedTermSet). Used as a typed concept reference (e.g., cdi:hasIntendedDataType / cdif:recommendedDataType point at an xsd-datatype DefinedTerm), and as one branch of CdifConceptOrTerm.

attribute.name: termCode
attribute.definition: schema:termCode - the code identifying the term within its DefinedTermSet.

attribute.name: inDefinedTermSet
attribute.definition: schema:inDefinedTermSet - @id of the DefinedTermSet this term belongs to.

class._comment: CdifConceptOrTerm - union shorthand used as the value type of cdif:uses. Admits a skos:Concept reference OR a schema:DefinedTerm. In JSON instances it MAY be replaced by a plain string (interpreted as the @id / prefLabel / termCode of the underlying concept or term) - i.e. the JSON value can be an inline object, an {@id} reference, or a bare string.
class.definition: Union shorthand for 'a concept reference (skos:Concept) OR a defined term (schema:DefinedTerm)'. In JSON instances the value MAY be: (a) an inline object typed as Concept / DefinedTerm, (b) an @id-only object referencing one, or (c) a plain string interpreted as the @id / prefLabel / termCode of the referenced concept or term. cdif:uses on a RepresentedVariable is typed by this union.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI of the concept or term being referenced.

association._comment: DataDownload -> CatalogRecord (via the dataset's schema:subjectOf back-ref).
association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this dataset's metadata. MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/data_structure/1.1.

association._comment: cdi:isStructuredBy: one edge per allowed structure variant (the schema's anyOf at distribution items.cdi:isStructuredBy).
association.definition: cdi:isStructuredBy - general DataStructure variant.
cdi:isStructuredBy - dimensional (cube) variant.
cdi:isStructuredBy - long (narrow) variant.
cdi:isStructuredBy - wide (tabular) variant.

association._comment: Generic cdi:has_DataStructureComponent on the abstract: any DataStructure has 1..* DataStructureComponent. The per-variant has-edges below specify which concrete subtypes each variant accepts.
association.definition: cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - generic: every DataStructure carries at least one component (any of the five RV-defined subtypes plus VariableDescriptorComponent).

association._comment: DataStructure (general) -> any of the 6 component subtypes via cdi:has_DataStructureComponent. One edge per allowed subtype (schema uses generic ref so all are allowed).
association.definition: cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - IdentifierComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - MeasureComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - AttributeComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - DimensionComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - VariableDescriptorComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - VariableValueComponent (general DataStructure accepts any subtype).

association._comment: DimensionalDataStructure -> Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension components only.
association.definition: cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Identifier components on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Measure components on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Attribute components on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Dimension components on a dimensional structure.

association._comment: LongDataStructure -> exactly one Identifier + VariableDescriptor + VariableValue, plus optional Attribute.
association.definition: cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - exactly one IdentifierComponent (long-format identifier column).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - exactly one VariableDescriptorComponent (names which InstanceVariable the row represents).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - exactly one VariableValueComponent (carries the value).
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - optional Attribute components.

association._comment: WideDataStructure -> Identifier / Measure / Attribute only.
association.definition: cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Identifier components on a wide structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Measure components on a wide structure.
cdi:has_DataStructureComponent - Attribute components on a wide structure.

association._comment: All DataStructure variants -> PrimaryKey via cdi:has_PrimaryKey (optional on all four).
association.definition: cdi:has_PrimaryKey - optional primary key on the general DataStructure.
cdi:has_PrimaryKey - optional primary key on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_PrimaryKey - optional primary key on a long structure.
cdi:has_PrimaryKey - optional primary key on a wide structure.

association._comment: DataStructure / DimensionalDataStructure / WideDataStructure -> ForeignKey via cdi:has_ForeignKey (LongDataStructure does NOT have foreign keys in the refined schema).
association.definition: cdi:has_ForeignKey - foreign keys on the general DataStructure variant.
cdi:has_ForeignKey - foreign keys on a dimensional structure.
cdi:has_ForeignKey - foreign keys on a wide structure.

association._comment: DimensionGroup -> the component subtypes via cdif:has_DataStructureComponent (schema uses generic ref).
association.definition: cdif:has_DataStructureComponent - IdentifierComponent (any subtype permitted).
cdif:has_DataStructureComponent - MeasureComponent (any subtype permitted).
cdif:has_DataStructureComponent - AttributeComponent (any subtype permitted).
cdif:has_DataStructureComponent - DimensionComponent (any subtype permitted).

association._comment: PrimaryKey -> RepresentedVariable via cdif:isComposedOf. Each item is a RepresentedVariable (or @id-reference) plus a required cdif:position integer (1-based position in the key).
association.definition: cdif:isComposedOf - the RepresentedVariables that make up the key.

association._comment: ForeignKey -> RepresentedVariable via cdi:isComposedOf.
association.definition: cdi:isComposedOf - the RepresentedVariables in this structure that make up the foreign key.

association._comment: ForeignKey -> PrimaryKey via cdi:references.
association.definition: cdi:references - the PrimaryKey on another DataStructure that this foreign key references.

association._comment: cdif:isDefinedBy: each DataStructureComponent (the abstract) is defined by a RepresentedVariable. Concrete RV-defined subtypes inherit via the generalization.
association.definition: cdif:isDefinedBy_RepresentedVariable - the RepresentedVariable that defines this DataStructureComponent.

association._comment: VariableDescriptorComponent is defined by a DescriptorVariable (NOT a RepresentedVariable), hence the standalone association.
association.definition: cdif:isDefinedBy_DescriptorVariable - the DescriptorVariable that defines this VariableDescriptorComponent.

association._comment: VariableDescriptorComponent -> VariableValueComponent: which VariableValueComponent the descriptor names.
association.definition: cdi:refersTo - the VariableValueComponent whose values are described by this VariableDescriptorComponent (long-format pairing).

association._comment: AttributeComponent -> MeasureComponent via cdi:qualifies (the attribute qualifies the value of a measure).
association.definition: cdi:qualifies - the MeasureComponent whose values this AttributeComponent qualifies.

association._comment: RepresentedVariable -> SubstantiveValueDomain via cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom (the valid, meaningful values).
association.definition: cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom - the substantive value domain of this RepresentedVariable.

association._comment: RepresentedVariable -> SentinelValueDomain via cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom (missing-value / not-applicable codes).
association.definition: cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom - the sentinel value domain (missing-value codes) of this RepresentedVariable.

association._comment: RepresentedVariable -> UnitType via cdi:measures (the kind of unit the variable measures).
association.definition: cdi:measures - the kind of unit (UnitType) this RepresentedVariable measures.

association._comment: RepresentedVariable -> CdifConceptOrTerm via cdif:uses. Concept-or-term reference(s) the variable measures/represents. CdifConceptOrTerm is a union shorthand; in JSON instances each value MAY be a plain string (interpreted as @id / prefLabel / termCode).
association.definition: cdif:uses - concept or term reference(s) for what this RepresentedVariable measures or represents. The value type is the CdifConceptOrTerm union (skos:Concept | schema:DefinedTerm | string shorthand).

association._comment: DescriptorVariable -> DescriptorValueDomain via cdif:hasValuesFrom.
association.definition: cdif:hasValuesFrom - the descriptor value domain of this DescriptorVariable.

association._comment: SubstantiveValueDomain -> ValueAndConceptDescription via cdi:isDescribedBy.
association.definition: cdi:isDescribedBy - description (ranges, patterns, classification level, ...) of the values/concepts this domain admits.
cdi:isDescribedBy - description of the sentinel (missing) values.
cdi:isDescribedBy - description of the descriptor values.

association._comment: SubstantiveValueDomain -> EnumerationDomain via cdif:takesValuesFrom (codelist-backed enumeration).
association.definition: cdif:takesValuesFrom - controlled-vocabulary codelist for the substantive values.
cdif:takesValuesFrom - controlled-vocabulary codelist for the sentinel values.
cdif:takesValuesFrom - controlled-vocabulary codelist for the descriptor values.
